description: cheat-terminal on the web: search your cheat sheets from the browser, backed by Cloudflare Workers + D1.
name: web-cheat-terminal

scripts.seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs > scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute cheat-terminal --local --file scripts/seed.sql
scripts.seed:remote: node scripts/seed.mjs > scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute cheat-terminal --remote --file scripts/seed.sql
